item.title: McNeese Basketball Returns to March Madness: Cowboys Eye Another 5-12 Upset
item.description:
McNeese Basketball Returns to March Madness: Cowboys Eye Another 5-12 Upset

Key Takeaways:

  • 12-seed McNeese faces 5-seed Vanderbilt on March 19 in Oklahoma City
  • The Cowboys upset 5-seed Clemson in last year’s first round as a 12-seed
  • Viral student manager Amir “Aura” Khan and his boombox are back for another March run
  • This is a classic 5-12 matchup — historically one of the most upset-prone seeds in the tournament

What are the odds that lightning strikes twice in the same spot? McNeese basketball is betting on exactly that as the Cowboys return to the NCAA Tournament with the same script that made them America’s Cinderella last March.

item.title: Tyler Tanner's Record-Breaking Run: How Vanderbilt Stormed the SEC Tournament
item.description:
A program that was once an afterthought in the SEC just knocked off the conference’s top seed. And a record-breaking defensive performance was at the heart of it all.

Quick Summary: Vanderbilt’s Tyler Tanner delivered a historic defensive performance as the Commodores took down top-seeded Florida 91-74 to reach the SEC Tournament final. This followed a 75-68 upset over Tennessee in the quarterfinals. Tanner’s back-to-back performances have been described as record-breaking, putting Vanderbilt in position for a deep March Madness run.
